title: Operational Audit
intro:
For CEOs, COOs, and sustainability directors at mid-to-large companies under real ESG pressure.

Your operations mapped, your ESG gap named, and a prioritized plan built into how the business actually runs — not bolted on after the fact.

title: Eco Home Build
intro:
For Owner-builders and off-grid planners past the Pinterest stage.

You stop circling the research loop and get a working framework — materials, insulation logic, and earthship principles mapped to decisions you can actually make on a real site.
